edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource, from the Wen Xuan anthology
edition.zh: 据维基文库所录《昭明文选》本

basis.en: Written in the early third century; the author died in 226.
basis.zh: 作于三世纪初，作者卒于 226 年。

note.en: Cao Pi wrote this as crown prince of Wei, and it is usually counted the first Chinese essay devoted to literature as such: how writers misjudge one another, why each form asks for different virtues, and why a style cannot be handed on. It ends with the claim that writing is 'a splendid undertaking that does not decay', outlasting both a lifetime and its honours. Notice that he ranks the Seven Masters of Jian'an even as he misses them; several had died in the epidemic of 217.
note.zh: 曹丕作为魏国太子时写下这篇文章，它通常被视为中国第一篇专门讨论文学本身的论文：文人怎样彼此误判，不同的文体为什么要求不同的长处，文风为什么无法传授。它以这样的论断收尾：文章是“不朽之盛事”，比寿命和荣华都更长久。留意他一边品评建安七子，一边怀念他们；其中好几位死于 217 年的那场疫病。

excerpt.orig: 蓋文章經國之大業，不朽之盛事。
excerpt.en: For writing is the great work of ordering a state, a splendid undertaking that does not decay.
excerpt.zh: 盖文章经国之大业，不朽之盛事。
